_ican.description: I Can statements for BC curriculum competencies (stage 3 of the bank rebuild), keyed by competency id in data/bc-curriculum-source.json. FullVision's wording, not the Ministry's. Written by cluster: one exemplar per cluster approved by the owner, every other wording adapted from it and checked by a reviewer.
_ican.raw_sha: sha256 of the competency's raw text (UTF-8), first 16 hex characters, as in data/bc-curriculum-derived.json
